sections.name: About High Fliers
sections.copy:
Who We Are

High Fliers Cross-Border Payments Limited (also known as High Fliers International Remittance Co) is a leading Nigerian fintech company specializing in secure, efficient cross-border payment solutions. Based in Maiduguri, Borno State, we serve clients across Nigeria and internationally, providing seamless remittance services that connect families, businesses, and communities worldwide.

Our Mission: To democratize international payments by making them accessible, affordable, and lightning-fast for every Nigerian, regardless of location.

Our Vision: To become Africa's most trusted cross-border payment platform, bridging the gap between Nigeria and the global economy.

Why Choose High Fliers?
• Fully Licensed & Regulated: We operate in full compliance with Nigerian financial regulations
• Competitive Exchange Rates: Get more value for every transaction
• Fast Transfers: Most transactions complete within minutes
• Secure Technology: Bank-grade encryption protects every transaction
• 24/7 Support: Our team is always here to assist you
• Pan-Nigerian Coverage: From Maiduguri to Lagos, we serve all Nigerians

Our leadership brings extensive experience from the Nigerian lending and fintech sectors, ensuring you receive world-class service backed by deep local expertise.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Comprehensive Cross-Border Payment Solutions

Personal Remittance
Send money to loved ones across Africa, Europe, Asia, and the Americas. Support your family with fast, secure transfers at competitive rates. Whether it's school fees, medical expenses, or regular support, we've got you covered.

Business Payments
Pay international suppliers, receive payments from global clients, and manage your business cash flow across borders. We support bulk payments, recurring transactions, and dedicated business accounts.

Bill Payments
Pay international bills, subscriptions, and services directly from Nigeria. From education fees to healthcare, technology subscriptions to property payments—we make it seamless.

Foreign Exchange
Access competitive foreign exchange rates for USD, GBP, EUR, and other major currencies. Lock in rates for future transactions with our forward contracts.

Agent Network
Join our growing network of agents across Nigeria. Earn commissions while helping your community access international payment services.

Mobile & Online Platform
Send money anytime, anywhere through our secure mobile app and web platform. Track transactions in real-time, save beneficiaries, and access transaction history at your fingertips.

Supported Corridors:
• Nigeria → USA, UK, Canada, Australia
• Nigeria → Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Rwanda
• Nigeria → UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar
• Nigeria → China, India, Malaysia
• And many more destinations worldwide

sections.name: How It Works
sections.copy:
Send Money in 3 Simple Steps

Step 1: Create Your Account
Register online or visit our Maiduguri office. Provide your valid ID (NIN, Driver's License, or International Passport) and complete our quick verification process. Account setup takes just minutes.

Step 2: Choose Your Destination & Amount
Select the recipient country, enter the amount you wish to send, and see the exact amount your beneficiary will receive. Our transparent pricing means no hidden fees—what you see is what you pay.

Step 3: Send & Track
Fund your transaction via bank transfer, card payment, or cash deposit at our office. Your money is on its way! Track your transfer in real-time and receive confirmation when your beneficiary collects their funds.

First-Time Sender?
Enjoy special rates on your first transaction. Our customer support team will guide you through every step to ensure a smooth experience.

Required Documents:
• Valid government-issued ID
• Proof of address (utility bill or bank statement)
• Beneficiary details (name, account number, bank details)

sections.name: Security & Compliance
sections.copy:
Your Security is Our Priority

At High Fliers Cross-Border Payments Limited, we understand that trust is earned through unwavering commitment to security and regulatory compliance.

Regulatory Compliance
• Licensed by relevant Nigerian financial regulatory authorities
• Full compliance with CBN guidelines on international money transfers
• Adherence to Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations
• Regular audits and reporting to regulatory bodies

Technology Security
• 256-bit SSL encryption for all online transactions
• Multi-factor authentication to protect your account
• Secure data centers with redundant backups
• PCI-DSS compliant payment processing
• Regular security audits and penetration testing

Your Privacy
We never share your personal information with third parties except as required by law or to complete your transaction. Your data is stored securely and protected by Nigerian data protection regulations.

Fraud Prevention
Our advanced fraud detection systems monitor transactions 24/7. Any suspicious activity triggers immediate investigation to protect your funds.

Dispute Resolution
In the unlikely event of a problem, our dedicated resolution team investigates and resolves issues within 48 hours. We maintain comprehensive insurance to protect your transactions.

sections.name: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.copy:
Your Questions Answered

How long does a transfer take?
Most transfers are completed within 30 minutes to 4 hours, depending on the destination country and payment method. Bank transfers may take up to 24 hours in some corridors.

What are your fees?
Our fees vary by destination, amount, and payment method. You'll see the exact fee before confirming any transaction. Typically, fees range from ₦500 to ₦3,000 plus competitive exchange rate margins. No hidden charges.

What is the maximum amount I can send?
Personal transfers: Up to $10,000 per transaction, $50,000 per year (subject to regulatory limits). Business transfers: Higher limits available upon verification. Contact us for custom arrangements.

Do I need to visit your office?
No. You can complete all transactions online or through our mobile app. However, first-time customers may need to visit for identity verification, or you can complete video verification remotely.

What documents do I need?
For registration: Valid government-issued ID (NIN, Driver's License, or International Passport) and proof of address. For large transactions: Additional source of funds documentation may be required.

Is my money safe?
Absolutely. We are licensed and regulated, use bank-grade security, and maintain transaction insurance. Your money is protected throughout the transfer process.

What if there's a problem with my transfer?
Contact our customer support immediately via phone or WhatsApp. We investigate all issues within 24 hours and resolve them within 48 hours. Full refund if we cannot complete your transfer.

Can I cancel a transfer?
Yes, before the funds are disbursed to the beneficiary. Cancellation fees may apply depending on how far the transaction has progressed.

Do you serve customers outside Maiduguri?
Yes! We serve all of Nigeria. You can transact entirely online from anywhere in the country.

How do I become an agent?
Contact us via phone or email to learn about our agent program. We provide training, marketing materials, and competitive commission structures.
